paper_title: Parameterized Complexity of the Anchored k-Core Problem for Directed Graphs
statement: Let us remark that this result can be easily extended for any class of directed acyclic graphs G such that the corresponding class of underlaying graphs {G∗ |G ∈ G} has (locally) bounded expansion by making use of the results by Dvorak et al. [11]. Finally, what happens when the input graph is planar? We know that the problem is NP-complete on planar graphs for fixed k ≥ 1 and maximum degree k + 2. Is the problem FPT on planar directed graphs when parameterized by the size of the core p?
